name: South terrace
purpose: The long outdoor porch along the hall front: blue-hour sea air, the cascade pools below on the west, and the cable lift's lit cabin climbing straight up the cliff to the summit glow.

ceiling_profile.note: Open sky; the timber hall facade and the cliff above it form the north side; the south edge drops toward the sea.

portals.note: Stone stair down 1.0 m (6 risers) to the cascade overlook.
Cable lift base (layout connection cable_lift.bottom). Not a walk link.

hero.why: The only lit thing that moves vertically on the south face: the glass cabin leaves this bronze-and-timber station and climbs the cable 120 m to the rim. Standing on the terrace your eye follows the cable line up to the summit glow, which ties ground to sky. Brightest object on the terrace (glazed station + lit cabin).

anchored.why: Where the cascade water sinks into the mountain (w_culvert top at (46,40), -4.2). A bronze grate over a steaming slot with the sound of falling water: the visible moment the spring goes underground.
Blossom tree on the south edge (plan 31 shows pink trees by the terrace stairs); breaks the long run.
East end is a dead-end lookout over the sea cliff: a reason to walk there.
The glass cabin 16 m up the cable, climbing: the vertical line of light the terrace exists to show.
The cabin's own lamp under its floor.

water.note: Covered channel under the terrace from the lowest cascade pool outflow to the sink at (46,40); slopes -3.97 -> -4.2 (w_culvert z_top); only visible through culvert_grate.

sightlines.see: The terrace lantern line running east; the lit cable cabin and its cable rising to the right.
Straight out south over the railing: sea and blue-hour sky; cascade pools glowing to the right.
Up the cable to the top station on the rim (96, 60, 120).
Sea stacks and surf below the east cliff.

concept.match: 01's mood looking down-and-west over terraced teal pools with stone toro in the foreground, steam, blue-hour sky, the carved arch of the hall glowing in the background right.

lights.why: Eave lanterns on the cable station so it is the brightest thing on the terrace.
Pools of light at the hall door, the gate door, the cable station and the east lookout; dark 15-30 m gaps between.
Sparse rail posts: overlook ends, station, mid-run, lookout.

dressing.note: Rail on the terrace paving at 0.0 (the slab edge bevels down).

dressing.why: West edge over the cascade pools.
dressing.note: Rail on the terrace paving at 0.0 (the slab edge bevels down).

dressing.why: Banners on the timber facade, wide spacing.
Windswept pines on the cliff edge break the long east run.
Rock groups at the east lookout and along the cliff rail between pines.
Overlook rail over the cascade pools, west of the stair head.
dressing.note: Rail on the terrace paving at 0.0 (the slab edge bevels down).

dressing.why: Same, east of the stair head.

mood.palette: deep blue sky, amber toro, bronze station glow, teal pools to the west
mood.mist: steam rising from the culvert grate and the cascade side

waivers.where: the walk between the light pools
waivers.reason: Review r1: light pools at the doors, station and lookout with dark 15-30 m gaps between are the design, not missing dressing.
